title: Submit internship application
description: Tailor the resume for the backend engineering role and send the application before the deadline.

title: Pay electricity bill
description: Review the current bill and complete the payment through the provider portal.

title: Schedule dentist appointment
description: Call the clinic to book a routine checkup for next week.

title: Prepare project presentation
description: Create slides showing the problem, solution, architecture, and demo flow.

title: Buy groceries
description: Pick up rice, vegetables, milk, and the ingredients needed for dinner.

title: Back up laptop files
description: Copy important documents and project folders to the external drive.

title: Renew library membership
description: Check the membership expiry date and submit the renewal form.

title: Book train tickets
description: Confirm travel dates and reserve seats for the family visit.

title: Organize desk drawers
description: Sort stationery, discard unused papers, and label the storage sections.

title: Send meeting notes
description: Share the decisions and action items with everyone who attended.

title: Water balcony plants
description: Check the soil moisture and water the pots that are dry.

title: Replace desk lamp
description: Measure the desk space and choose a lamp with suitable brightness.

title: Return borrowed novel
description: Drop the book at the library before the return date.

title: Plan weekend outing
description: Compare nearby places, estimate the cost, and decide the departure time.

title: Clean refrigerator shelves
description: Remove expired food, wipe the shelves, and arrange containers neatly.

title: Review monthly expenses
description: Categorize recent transactions and identify areas to reduce spending.

title: Collect parcel from office
description: Bring the tracking number and identification to the delivery counter.

title: Update portfolio website
description: Add the latest project summary, screenshots, and repository link.

title: Prepare lunch for tomorrow
description: Cook the meal in advance and store it in a sealed container.

title: Check bicycle brakes
description: Inspect the brake pads and test the levers before the next ride.

title: Register for coding contest
description: Complete the participant form and verify the contest schedule.

title: Wash bedsheets
description: Run a laundry cycle and put the clean sheets back on the bed.

title: Draft community newsletter
description: Write a short update about upcoming events and recent announcements.

title: Install security updates
description: Apply available operating system updates and restart the laptop.

title: Reserve badminton court
description: Check available evening slots and confirm the booking with friends.

title: Sort photos by date
description: Move pictures into yearly folders and remove duplicate copies.

title: Prepare science fair model
description: Gather the materials, assemble the model, and practice the explanation.

title: Confirm hotel reservation
description: Verify the booking details and save the confirmation message.

title: Clean keyboard and monitor
description: Use a microfiber cloth and safe cleaning method for the devices.

title: Submit workshop feedback
description: Complete the feedback form and mention the most useful session.
